expectations.text: The skill reads or references actions.ts before writing component code
expectations.evidence: Summary lists reading actions.ts in the Observations section before proposing code

expectations.text: An npx shadcn add command is listed before any shadcn import statements
expectations.evidence: Pre-requisites section shows 'npx shadcn@latest add card button input label select badge separator' before code — HOWEVER uses @latest (fine) and includes more components than needed (separator, select, label)

expectations.text: All user-visible strings in proposed code are in Hebrew (not English)
expectations.evidence: Code uses: הכלבים שלי, עדיין לא נוספו כלבים, מטיילים מוקצים, מחיר (₪), קבע מחיר, בחר מטייל, שיבוץ, הסרה, הוסף כלב, שם, גזע, תאריך לידה, הערות — all Hebrew

expectations.text: New presentational component(s) are proposed in src/components/ (not inlined in page.tsx)
expectations.evidence: Without-skill agent put ALL code directly into page.tsx with no separate component files created. No src/components/ files proposed.

expectations.text: No modifications proposed to actions.ts or any file in src/db/, src/lib/repositories/, src/lib/auth/
expectations.evidence: Summary states 'actions.ts requires no changes' and no backend files mentioned

expectations.text: Tailwind classes follow mobile-first pattern (base for mobile, sm:/md: for larger screens)
expectations.evidence: Uses sm:px-6, md:max-w-2xl, sm:w-auto — mobile-first with breakpoint overrides. However adds dir=rtl to <main> which the skill explicitly forbids.
